errors.text_span: Eine blaue, gestrichelte Linie stellt den Anteil der Erwerbsbevölkerung von Personen dar, die zugewandert sind und bis 2010 zugewandert sind
errors.evidence: The light blue line (zugewandert bis 2009) is solid, not dashed. The dark blue line (zugewandert seit 2010) is also solid.
The machine-generated description incorrectly assigns the dark blue line as dashed, but it is solid. Also, it misassigns the light blue line's description to the dark blue line.
The description does not clearly state that the chart shows the share of employed individuals by age and migration background, as highlighted in the reference.
The description omits the tick intervals on the y-axis (every 20%), which are mentioned in the reference.
The description omits the dark blue line (zugewandert seit 2010) entirely, which is a key data series in the figure.

errors.text_span: Das Diagramm stellt den Anteil der Erwerbsbevölkerung in Deutschland seit 2010 in Bezug auf das Alter nach Migrationshintergrund dar
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the chart represents data 'seit 2010' (since 2010), which is not mentioned or implied in the figure or reference.
The description includes an interpretive phrase ('langsam sinkenden Trend') that is not explicitly shown or necessary for factual description.
